newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Three miners die in Deelkraal seismic event.
newsitem.headline: Three miners die in Deelkraal seismic event.

text.p: Deelkraal Gold Mining Co said on Wednesday three employees died following a seismic event at 2,600 metres below surface in an area served by the No 1 sub-shaft at around noon.
Another 18 employees sustained injuries of varying severity, Deelkraal said in a statement.
Nine employees from the same area in the mine where the event occurred were still unaccounted for. Rescue operations were continuing.
Deelkraal could not be reached immediately.
It did not say whether production had been affected by the event which measured 3.3 on the Richter Scale.
The mine said the injured men had been taken to a hospital in the town of Carletonville.
